notes: Welcome to 1.18.2 Shaders (Experimental)! The MakeUp Ultra Fast shaders are built in and on from the start: sunlight and sky colours, fog and haze, sunsets, starry nights, shiny water, and a torch in your hand that lights up what's around you.
Options > Shaders turns them off or picks a profile (No Effects, Shadowless Low, Medium or High). Press K in game to switch them on and off.
It's experimental: no shadows yet, and on slower computers the shaders draw at a lower resolution to keep things moving. Your worlds and settings are the same ones as in the regular 1.18.2.
